Gilded Minotaurs are a rare variant of Minotaurs with golden skin which are summoned by  Helsik.

About Gilded Minotaurs

Unlike normal Minotaurs, this variant has a body with the appearance of gold and is significantly more powerful in combat. Gilded Minotaurs in the presence of Helsik have the  Infectious Greed condition; it can be removed by killing Helsik.
